mapper.select: INSERT INTO app_rag_requests(id,user_id,request_key,request_hash,state,instance_id) VALUES (#{id,jdbcType=OTHER},#{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT},#{requestKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{requestHash,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'running',#{instanceId,jdbcType=OTHER}) ON CONFLICT(user_id,request_key) DO NOTHING RETURNING id
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM app_rag_requests WHERE session_id=#{sessionId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND state='running')
mapper.update: UPDATE app_rag_requests SET state='completed',response=#{response,jdbcType=VARCHAR}::jsonb,updated_at=now() WHERE id=#{id,jdbcType=OTHER} AND state='running'
UPDATE app_rag_requests SET state='failed',error_code=#{errorCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR},updated_at=now() WHERE id=#{id,jdbcType=OTHER} AND state='running'
mapper.select: SELECT q.original_query,q.rewritten_query,g.generated_answer FROM rag_queries q JOIN generation_traces g ON g.query_id=q.id JOIN rag_sessions s ON s.id=q.session_id WHERE s.id=#{sessionId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND s.user_id=#{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND q.workflow_state='completed' ORDER BY q.id DESC LIMIT 3

UPDATE app_rag_requests SET state='cancelled',updated_at=now() WHERE user_id=#{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND request_key=#{requestKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND state='running' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM rag_sessions s WHERE s.id=app_rag_requests.session_id AND s.target_scope->>'deletedAt' IS NULL) RETURNING id,query_id
mapper.update: UPDATE app_rag_requests SET state='failed',error_code='REQUEST_TIMEOUT',updated_at=now() WHERE id=#{id,jdbcType=OTHER} AND state='running'
UPDATE rag_queries SET workflow_state='failed',error_code='REQUEST_TIMEOUT',completed_at=now() WHERE id=(SELECT query_id FROM app_rag_requests WHERE id=#{requestId,jdbcType=OTHER})
mapper.select: UPDATE app_rag_requests SET state='failed',error_code='WORKER_INTERRUPTED',updated_at=now() WHERE state='running' AND lease_until<now() RETURNING query_id
